title: Cloudflare Joins the Jevolution and Labels Itself a Neolab
author: Richard MacManus
description: Cloudflare made its name speeding up the web. Now it's building System One models to make decisions and pull data in milliseconds.
summary: Cloudflare has been one of the essential infrastructure companies of the web for the past decade and a half. But now, it’s turning into a neolab — at least according to a presentation at AI Engineer Code Summit by Michelle Chen , who runs Cloudflare’s AI Platform on the product side.
takeaways: We’ll get into what exactly a neolab is in a minute (the short version: they build models and they’re not called OpenAI or Anthropic).

We opened it, now the possibilities are endless.” Chen said it’s “not just system one models, but potentially reasoning models that we've been experimenting with, and other LLMs and whatnot.” However, she added that these probably won’t be pre-trained models built from scratch, like the frontier labs produce.

“I don't think that's our focus, but I think we can take existing resources out there and make [them] a lot more efficient and effective.” She noted that “most of our team really just does post-training,” so that will be the focus in model development.
